summary: Focana 2.4.7 makes returning from Pomodoro breaks more flexible and keeps compact timers in place.
improvements: Pomodoro break actions now say Keep working and return to Choose time, so the next focus block can be five minutes, another custom timer, Freeflow, or a fresh Pomodoro.
The current task and accumulated focus time carry forward while choosing the next work duration.
fixes: Keep working no longer silently assumes another 25-minute Pomodoro interval.
A Pomodoro break that expands from compact mode now returns the next active timer to the same compact size, including after the break window reloads.
